_comment: SPARK — S167: veo clips for the SIX TIER-9 BOSSES. Four states each (idle / walk / attack / die).
⭐ EVERY CLIP IS SEEDED IMAGE-TO-VIDEO OFF THAT BOSS'S OWN approved PNG. That is the mechanism
behind the owner's binding requirement — the seed image carries the DESIGN and the prompt carries
only the MOTION. A text prompt alone yields a different boss per clip. The six seeds here are the
REV-2 art the owner approved in S166; they are deliberately grounded READY stances precisely so
one seed can drive all four of these.
⭐ EACH PROMPT IS WRITTEN TO THAT BOSS'S OWNER-GIVEN FEAR AXIS, not to a generic 'scary monster'.
The owner fixed the axes himself when the art was made: Vlad IMPERIAL, Kraken MONSTROUS, Pharaoh
ANCIENT & CURSED, Whopper DISGUSTING, Warlord BRUTAL, Archdemon VICIOUS & TERRIFYING. R99 already
forbids two RACES converging; six bosses that all moved the same way would collapse the same
distinction at the point the player actually sees it — in motion.
⚠ THE SUBJECT PHRASE IS SHORT ON PURPOSE. Long re-descriptions are what made veo REDRAW the
subject each frame instead of animating a fixed one — the shipped stink tower melted for exactly
that reason (see gen-character-clips.mjs). Identity in one clause, motion in the rest.
⛔ NO SKILL CLIPS HERE, AND THAT IS THE OWNER'S OWN SEQUENCING. He gave three of the six skill
sets mid-session (R138 zombie aura + death explosion, R139 kraken tentacles + sonar cone, R140
vlad conversion + life sap) and reserved Pharaoh, Warlord and Archdemon: *"the rest iil think
about while you give me the stats"*. Skill art is owed for all six once they are settled — he
asked for it explicitly: *"we would need to generate cool graphics for those abilities"*.
⚠ `die` IS GENERATED EVEN THOUGH NO RENDERER ARM CAN REQUEST ROW 3 TODAY. goblinRenderer's
syncSprite maps every FSM state to attack/walk/idle, so the die row is currently unreachable —
the same state the tier-3 units ship in. It is generated now because the seed and the prompt are
in hand now, and re-generating later costs another full veo pass.

idle.prompt: the tall gaunt vampire voivode in his high-collared crimson-and-black robes stands in place . He shifts his weight slightly and his head turns as he surveys the field. He never hurries and never crouches; every motion is unhurried, upright and contemptuous. He stays in the SAME SPOT for the whole clip and does not walk anywhere.

walk.prompt: the tall gaunt vampire voivode in his high-collared crimson-and-black robes advances steadily forward toward the viewer , a full walk cycle. He never hurries and never crouches; every motion is unhurried, upright and contemptuous. He stays roughly centred in frame the whole time.

attack.prompt: the tall gaunt vampire voivode in his high-collared crimson-and-black robes delivers one single heavy attack - a full wind-up, the strike, and the recovery back to a ready stance, all within the clip. He never hurries and never crouches; every motion is unhurried, upright and contemptuous. He stays in the SAME SPOT and does not travel.

die.prompt: the tall gaunt vampire voivode in his high-collared crimson-and-black robes is struck a mortal blow. He staggers, collapses and FALLS ONTO THE GROUND. He is already fully down by the middle of the clip. For the entire second half he lies motionless on the ground, completely still, not moving at all. He never hurries and never crouches; every motion is unhurried, upright and contemptuous.
